injection_near_overlap.action: audited but not removed from the retained baseline; new rows matching locked evaluation are quarantined before training
injection_near_overlap.method: 128-bit SimHash over word unigrams+bigrams, eight 16-bit bands, Hamming <= 6, five-word minimum; documents over 24,000 characters use contiguous 8,000-character head, middle, and tail windows
injection_near_overlap.scope: materialized train rows against validation and dev-test rows

routing_deduplication.near_method: 128-bit SimHash over word unigrams+bigrams, eight 16-bit bands, Hamming <= 6, five-word minimum; documents over 24,000 characters use contiguous 8,000-character head, middle, and tail windows
routing_deduplication.partition_method: exact deduplication, official-dev locking, 70/10/20 iterative source/label targets, then deterministic weighted lineage placement
routing_deduplication.storage: temporary SQLite index; canonical JSONL source shards remain authoritative

hackaprompt.split_grouping: whole challenge level; session_id is retained by hash but is not claimed as participant identity

multi_turn.projection: Prompt is detector text; goals, multi-turn histories, and target responses are retained by digest and remain reproducible from pinned source files

excluded_files.raw-data/v1: superseded by the pinned v2 raw dumps

bipia.license: MIT attacks; mixed benchmark context licenses
bipia.use: channel-specific indirect-injection train/test with clean-context controls

browsesafe.use: whole-document browser injection train and official test

gandalf.use: human direct-injection data; official train only for fitting

hackaprompt.use: gated human direct attack attempts; user_input only

llmail.use: human adaptive email injection; phase 1 fit, phase 2 evaluation

multi_turn.use: out-of-source obfuscated-jailbreak test grouped by goal

nemotron_agentic_ipi.use: synthetic successful agentic indirect-injection evaluation only; never direct-user training

notinject.use: locked trigger-word hard negatives for measuring over-defense

oasst1.use: multilingual weak injection controls; auxiliary for broad routing

prompt_injections.use: train and same-source test; direct prompt-injection label

tensor_trust.license: public research release; no explicit standard dataset license
tensor_trust.use: human prompt-injection robustness evaluation only; never training

tensor_trust_raw.use: human game attack attempts; grouped development data

toxic_chat.use: train and same-source test; explicit jailbreak label

wildguardmix.use: gated prompt harmfulness data for the routing target

wildjailbreak.use: gated four-way harmful/benign and adversarial contrast data

xstest.use: hard-negative test; safe and unsafe requests are not attacks

targets.injection_label: channel-scoped jailbreak or prompt-injection attack attempt; retained for the existing sensors
targets.injection_subtype_training_eligible: false when injection subtype is unknown or exact-duplicate injection annotations disagree; routing, harmfulness, or toxicity supervision may still be valid
targets.routing_label: 0 only for a source-supported benign row; 1 for injection, jailbreak, harmful non-injection, toxic, or uncertain content requiring a downstream decision
targets.security_tags: independent tags for instruction subversion, subtype, harmful intent, toxicity, benignness, or unresolved labels; use masked multi-task losses rather than forcing mutually exclusive classes
